title: data-dictionary.html
content: The {{variable.Feature_DataDictionary}} feature provides the flexibility to override button labels and other static text on your hosted {{variable.Object_Event}} pages. This gives you the ability to further customize the experience for your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s, and even better, it supports multi-language {{variable.Object_Event}} s and merge fields as well! Required Permission Sets and Licensing To use the Data Dictionary feature, you must also have a Blackthorn Payments license, as well as access to the following objects: Data Dictionary Group: Create/Read/Update Data Dictionary Entry: Create/Read/Update Supported Languages We do not currently support all languages. The following is a list of the languages we support.  Arabic      Chinese (Simplified)      Chinese (Traditional) Czech      Danish      Dutch      Finnish      French German      Haitian Creole      Hindi      Hmong      Hungarian      Indonesian      Italian      Japanese      Korean      Norwegian      Polish      Portuguese      Romanian      Russian      Somali Spanish      Swedish      Thai      Turkish      Vietnamese   One-to-One Relationship for Keys and Values For each Data Dictionary Entry’s {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} , there can only be one {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} per {{variable.Field_DataDictionary_Key}} . Creating a new Data Dictionary Entry for an existing {{variable.Field_DataDictionary_Key}} will replace the current {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} with the new one. Create a Data Dictionary Group If a label or button isn't translating correctly (we use Google Translate) or if you want to override a value with your own label, you can manually define the label for your {{variable.Object_Event}} . If you want to override out-of-the-box values, the first step is to create a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} and populate it with Data Dictionary Entries. In the App Launcher, enter and click "Data Dictionary Group". Click {{variable.button_new}} . Enter a {{variable.Field_DataDict_DataDictGrpName}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Click {{variable.button_new}} next to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} . In a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} , each {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} can only support one language. The {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_DataDictValu}} field contains the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} , {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} , and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} . There can only be one {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} per {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} for each {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} . Creating a new entry for an existing {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} will replace the current {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} with the new one. Click here for the full Events Data Dictionary list. Capital letters must be used in the  {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}}  field.  These are some of the most frequently used options.  {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "ACT_ADD_ATTENDEE" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = " Add Attendee" {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "ACT_DONE" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = " Done" {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_FREE" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = " Free" {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "ACT_REGISTER" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = " Registration" {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "MSG_REGISTRATION_CONFIRMED" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = " You are registered!" Select the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} you'd like to change.  Enter a {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} . Click Add Row to add additional entries or click {{variable.Button_Save}} .  Click Back to return to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} record. If you need to add additional keys to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} , click the menu (upside down triangle) next to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} . From there, click Add Row to add a new {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} . When you are done, click {{variable.Button_Save}} and Back to return to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} . USE CAPITAL LETTERS Use capital letters in the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} field. Example For this example, we will set {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} = "English". Now, we can select any word or phrase to replace an action with. For this example, we set {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “ACT_COMPLETE“ and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = “Complete”. Make sure to use all capital letters for the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} .  Here's the expected result. However, if we were to change {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = "Complete" to {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = "Test", this would be the result. Override a Specific Key Event Webpages If you are looking for a specific {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} you want to override, click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventPageURL}} field, and swap the language in the domain with "debug". You will see the keys on a specific {{variable.Object_Event}} , or in other words, the debugged version of the {{variable.Object_Event}} with each field identified.  See the images below to see how swapping "https://events.blackthorn.io/en/" with "https://events.blackthorn.io/debug/" shows the keys. "https://events.blackthorn.io/en/" "https://events.blackthorn.io/debug/" The Keys/Values on this Event webpage are the following. {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “LBL_SEARCH” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “Search” {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “ACT_GET_TICKETS” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “Get Tickets” {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “LBL_SECTION_OVERVIEW” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “Overview” {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “LBL_MONTH_APRIL” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “April” {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “LBL_STARTING_FROM_PRICE” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “Starting from” {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “LBL_SECTION_DATE_AND_TIME” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “Date & Time” Forms If you are looking for a specific {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} you want to override on a Form, open the {{variable.Field_Form_FormURL}} in a new tab. In this example, the {{variable.Field_Form_FormURL}} is “https://events.blackthorn.io/5e3TRCE7/s/…” Add “debug” after “events.blackthorn.io/”. You can now see the Keys on a specific Form, or in other words, the debugged version of the Form with each field identified. The debugged URL is “https://events.blackthorn.io/debug/5e3TRCE7/s/…” The Keys/Values on this Form are the following. {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “MSG_SURVEY_TITLE” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “Thank you for attending this event. Please take a few moments to answer our survey.” {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “ACT_COMPLETE” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “Complete” Add a Data Dictionary Group to an Event Settings Record Open an {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_DataDictGrp}} field. Select a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .  Remove the Paid/Free Verbiage IMPORTANT: This currently only applies to the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} . There are currently two ways to remove the "Free" and "$XX.XX" pricing. Reach out to {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to disable this throughout the entire org. If you would like to only remove the "Free" verbiage from the {{variable.Object_Event}} registration, you can do so by setting the {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} field to a "Space bar" entry. Going back to this Google Document , we can find the key we're looking for. In this case, let's remove the "Free" from the Subtotal column. The key we will be using is LBL_SUBTOTAL. Next, for the Value field, simply click the space bar to enter an empty value. And voila! Now, we can see that the text has been removed from the page. With the {{variable.Feature_DataDictionary}} , it is completely up to you what you'd like each field to represent in your checkout process. Use Merge Fields with Data Dictionary While we do not support merge fields in the {{variable.Feature_DataDictionary}} out of the box, we do have ICU formatted messages that, by default, give you the ability to insert dynamic text within the message. Syntax is {variable}. Click here for more information on Salesforce Supported ICU Formats. Use Cases Use Case 1 - Change the Welcome Message To update the text in the “Personal Welcome Message” message that appears in the AttendeeLink, set {{variable.Field_DataDictionary_Key}} = “MSG_ATTLINK_PERSONAL” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = text that includes the Attendee’s "{name}". The Attendee’s {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_FirstName}} will automatically be added. Example: Welcome {name}. Thank you for your interest in the upcoming event. Use Case 2 - Update the Starting From Price To override the “Starting from {price}” on the Event’s webpage, set {{variable.Field_DataDictionary_Key}} = “LBL_STARTING_FROM_PRICE” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = text that includes “{price}”. The cost of the lowest-priced Event Item will automatically be added. Example: Price starts at {price}! Use Case 3 - Change the Registration Canceled Message To override the text in the “Registration Canceled” message that appears in the AttendeeLink, set {{variable.Field_DataDictionary_Key}} = “MSG_REGISTRATION_CANCELED” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = text that includes "{name}" and "{date}". The {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} and {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventStartDate}} will automatically be added. Example: Your registration to {name} on {date} is canceled. Use Case 4 – Modify the Get Tickets Button To change the text on the Get Tickets button to “Join or Renew Membership”, set {{variable.Field_DataDictionary_Key}} = “ACT_GET_TICKETS” and {{variable.Field_DataDict_Value}} = “Join or Renew Membership".
